# Skein 0.6.1

Skein is a tiny zero-dependency HTML-first Web Components runtime with fine-grained native-DOM reactivity.

Canonical sources:
- README.md — user-facing guide
- llms-full.txt — expanded machine-oriented model
- .agents/skills/skein/references/syntax.md — exact syntax
- .agents/skills/skein/references/architecture.md — runtime invariants
- examples/workspace/ — 18-component application-scale composition reference
- examples/studio/ — Web Audio/Canvas composition reference

Core model:
- component tags map to HTML files: `<user-card>` → `user/card.html`;
- source is fetched before Skein claims an unknown custom-element tag;
- component `this` is reactive state;
- arrays and plain/null-prototype objects are recursively reactive;
- Date/Map/Set/DOM/platform/class instances stay native/opaque;
- shared raw objects keep one Skein Proxy identity across components;
- bindings are strict paths: `{user.name}`, `.value={name}`, `?disabled={saving}`, `@click={save}`, `--accent={theme.accent}`;
- `--name={path}` updates that CSS custom property with `element.style.setProperty()`; null/undefined/false remove only that property, while `0` remains valid;
- CSS custom-property bindings do not serialize or replace `style`; ordinary static inline declarations coexist and host variables inherit through Shadow DOM;
- do not combine per-property bindings with reactive whole-`style={path}` on the same element because the writes have competing ownership;
- derived logic belongs in `computed()`;
- lists use `each={items}` and usually `key={id}`; native `for={inputId}` stays HTML;
- conditions use `if={visible}`;
- composition is browser-native: properties carry live data down, bubbling+composed CustomEvents carry actions up, native `<slot>` carries content/layout;
- `input('name', fallback)` declares child input state;
- pre-mount property > static primitive attribute > fallback when initializing an input;
- static primitive attributes are initial seeds only; use `.property={path}` for live values and all objects/functions;
- input names cannot shadow HTMLElement/Skein host APIs;
- composed events can cross nested Shadow DOM boundaries without relay handlers;
- disconnect pauses; `host.dispose()` permanently destroys;
- cleanup uses `onCleanup()` or `abortSignal`;
- no virtual DOM, SSR, hydration, suspense, event bus, provide/inject, framework slot API, public batch/signal/untrack/stats/flush APIs.

Public API: `Skein.version`, `Skein.define(tag, source)`.

Production: 15,839 B raw / 5,686 B gzip / 5,123 B Brotli.
